info.name: Lex Machina Alerts ITC Investigations API

params.name: document_retrieval
params.description: 'all' to retrieve all documents for the investigation, if not provided documents will not be returned.

items.docs:
Gets data for a single US ITC investigation.

- **itc_investigation_id**: the ITC investigation number
- **docket_retrieval**: docket retreival mode

The investigation number format should exclude the leading "337-TA-"
